## Rotarod Analysis

### Experimental conditions

2 groups of mice:

LOG DATA: _No Crash of the system, all data can be used_

-> all data can be used    

Path to all Raw data files: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\analysis\Rotarod` 

Data: 
 
`Rotarod_1.CSV`    

The analysis of the data is done in this Rmd file directly.  

Path to Report: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\Rotarod`    

### Data Quality:  
->All data can be used. 

```{r data_loading}

# Empty global environment
rm(list = ls())

### 1.0 LOAD IN DATA ----------------------------------------------------------

# load data
raw_data_file <- "~\\6. Data from Behavioral Tests\\rotarod\\Rotarod_1.CSV"

columns_name <- read.table(raw_data_file,skip=16,dec = ",",sep=";")[1,]
columns_name[1] <- "animal_no"

raw_data <- read.table(raw_data_file,skip=17,dec = ",",sep=";")

colnames(raw_data) <- columns_name

raw_data <- raw_data %>% 
  mutate(animal_no = as.character(animal_no))
         
raw_data$animal_no[raw_data$animal_no == 1995] <- 1915

# load lookup data files
lookupfile <- "~\\6. Data from Behavioral Tests\\lookup.xlsx"

# read lookup data files
lookup <- read_excel(paste(lookupfile,sep = ""))

lookup <- lookup %>% 
  mutate(animal_no = as.character(`animal number`),
         cohort = as.character(cohort)) 

# combine exp data with lookup data
data <- full_join(raw_data,lookup , by= "animal_no")

data$cohort <- as.numeric(data$cohort)

# need to be factor for later stat analysis
data <- data %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group),
         cohort = factor(cohort),
         gender = factor(sex))

data <- data %>%
   dplyr::select(animal_no, cohort, gender, group, Sec, rpm, m)
                 
# data_new <- data %>%
#   group_by(animal_no) %>%
#   mutate(mean_sec = mean(Sec, na.rm = TRUE))  

summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(animal_no,cohort,gender,group) %>%  
  summarise(mean_sec = mean(Sec, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_rpm = mean(rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_m = mean(m, na.rm = TRUE))

#lapply(summary_data,class)

#names(summary_data)

```
\newpage

### Results

#### Time spent on Rod

```{r fig1, fig.align = "left", fig.width=9, fig.height=4}

# stats fig1a
stat_1a <- summary_data %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(group = droplevels(group)) %>%  # Drop unused factor levels
  wilcox_test(mean_sec ~ group, exact = FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%  
  add_xy_position(x = "group")  # needs to be included

# plot fig1a
pl_1a <- summary_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = mean_sec, color = group, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +  
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(3000,10500)) +
  labs(title="Total time on rod (s)", x="", y = "Time (s)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_1a

################################# 

# stats fig1b
stat_1b <- summary_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  wilcox_test(mean_sec ~ gender, exact = FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "group")  # needs to be included

# plot fig1b
pl_1b <- summary_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = mean_sec, color = gender, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +  
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(3000,10500)) +
  labs(title="Total time on rod (s)", x="", y = "Time (s)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +   
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_1b

#################################  

# arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig1 <- ggarrange(pl_1a, pl_1b, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=1, common.legend=F, legend = "bottom")

fig1

```

__Figure 1.__ Total time (s) on rod between groups (A) and between gender within group (B).

__Statistics for Figure 1 A (between groups)__

```{r stat_1a, echo=F}

#create a tibble to collect all stats

stat_1a %>%
  dplyr::select(-y.position,-groups,-xmin,-xmax) %>%  
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))

```

__Statistics for Figure 1 B (between gender)__

```{r stat_1b, echo=F}

#create a tibble to collect all stats

stat_1b %>%
  dplyr::select(-y.position,-groups,-x,-xmin,-xmax) %>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))

```
